name: whatsapp/self-chat
description: From WhatsApp Web's chat list, open 'Message yourself'.

steps.note: The chat list syncs for a few seconds after load.
The panel SLIDES in. Clicking the row while it moves is the 'you clicked so fast' failure.

MEASURED: the row is '@adenizy (You) Message yourself' and needs a REAL click with Chrome in front - its UIA Invoke reports success and does nothing. The actuator now takes the window back before falling to Invoke.
